decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) The proposed conversion of the single-family house to 1x three bedroom house, 1x one bedroom flat and 1x one bedroom maisonette incorporating a two storey side extension and a roof extension, would result in the loss of a small family house for which there is an identified need in the Borough. The proposal would not provide satisfactory living accommodation for future residents, contrary to Council Supplementary Planning Guidance.  For these reasons, the proposal is contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines).

2) The conversion of an existing single family house to form three flats would be harmful to neighbours' living conditions, through increased noise and disturbance. Contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

3) The two storey side extension and rear dormer extension fail to relate well to their site. They would harm the appearance of the front and rear elevation of the house and the surrounding street scene by reason of their position, design and, with regard the rear dormer, scale. Therefore the proposal would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

4) The proposal provides insufficient on-site parking, contrary to Council car parking standards, which would generate additional on street parking harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of a two storey side extension, roof extension and conversion of property into 1 X three bed house, 1 X one bed flat and 1 X one bed maisonette.
